items.title: maintenanceMay 14, 2026V.268 Known IssuesHere you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.268 - Maple University: 21st Anniversary update.
items.body:
MAINTENANCE
May 14, 2026
V.268 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.268 - Maple University: 21st Anniversary update:

KNOWN ISSUES
Cash Shop
The 'Buy' button is missing when purchasing Luna Crystals from the Special tab in the Cash Shop. This issue will be resolved in the next maintenance. While we address this issue, Luna Crystals can still be purchased using the following workaround (pets must be toggled On in the Preview UI for this to work):
Double click a pet from the list of obtainable items.
Equip the Luna Crystal so it appears in the preview cart.
Select 'Buy All' to open the checkout window then complete the purchase and it will appear in your Cash Inventory.
Rock Star Rock Spirit!
We have identified an issue regarding the Rock Star Rock Spirit! event. While we investigate this issue, we have temporarily disabled both Simple Colored Paper and Fancy Colored Paper from being opened.
[Updated 4/22/2026] We have identified an issue in the Rock Star Rock Spirit event where Simple and Fancy Colored Paper are being obtained at exactly 100 times the intended amount. As a temporary measure, the amount of Colored Paper required for use will be increased by 100 times. During the next maintenance, the Colored Paper acquisition amount, required usage amount, and current holdings will all be adjusted to their originally intended values, and we will ensure there is no impact on actual event progress. Further details will be provided at a later date. We apologize for the inconvenience.
Academic Capture!?
A participation pop-up window for Academic Capture!? appears while using Mystic Frontier.
General
The Hexagonal Star Staff is incorrectly appearing as part of the Brilliant Archangel Set instead of the Starlight Adventurer Set. This issue will be resolved in the next maintenance.
Players using the Steam client would sometimes disconnect from the game when opening the Familiar UI. We recommend players to try verifying integrity of the game files and restarting the client.
Playing the preview videos in the character selection screen would sometimes disconnect the client. While we address this issue, character preview videos have been temporarily disabled and will be enabled again in the v.269 update.
RESOLVED ISSUES
May 14, 2026
An issue where the Basic Damage Skin (Unit) from the Monster Election could be claimed abnormally has been resolved.
Further measures will be taken at a later date for the abnormally claimed damage skins.
April 30, 2026
Resolved an issue where the 'I Finally Turned 21!' title description in-game incorrectly listed the Bonus EXP as +100% instead of +40%.
Resolved an issue where the Receipt Damage Skin incorrectly displayed as the Wooden Damage Skin.
April 27, 2026
Resolved an issue where the Ethereal Atelier granted the Key to Love instead of the Angelic Birthday Candle. For those who received the "Key to Love" instead of the "Angelic Birthday Candle", we will distribute the correct item to you for the amount you received as soon as possible. We will provide an update once the issue is fully resolved. We apologize for the inconvenience.
[Updated 4/27/2026 at 10:50 PST] Distribution has been completed for affected players. We ask players to please re-enter the game and check the Gift Drop feature to claim the items. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
April 24, 2026
Resolved an issue where after purchasing a Premium Pass, a 'locked' overlay would sometimes still appear over the rewards UI preventing players from pressing the buttons. Please restart your game client for the fix to be applied.
Resolved an issue where the Maple Pixel Hero Outfit Set could not be obtained in the Maple Pixel Hero Outfit Set Exchange Coupon from the Maple University Meso Shop.
April 23, 2026
Resolved an issue where the Plasma Heart Upgrade Module could not be purchased from the Campus Point Shop.
Resolved an issue where players who had items listed in the Auction House could not world leap from Challenger Worlds.

MAINTENANCE
Apr 28, 2026
[COMPLETED] SCHEDULED MINOR PATCH - APRIL 30, 2026

[Updated April 30 at 11:30 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed and we have extended Cash Shop items in your inventory for 7 hours. Please restart your Nexon Launcher or Steam to ensure you receive the latest client update.

We will be performing a scheduled minor patch maintenance starting on Thursday, April 30, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 7 hours, concluding around 12:00 PM PDT (3:00 PM EDT / 9:00 PM CEST / 5:00 AM AEST May 1).

Times:

Thursday, April 30, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 12:00 PM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 3:00 PM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 9:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 5:00 AM May 1

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory game servers.

Changes and Updates:

MapleStory will be updated to v.268.3.0.
Monthly Windows update.
[Updated 4/30] Simple Colored Paper and Fancy Colored Paper will be collected from all character Inventories, Storage Room, and the Auction House, then redistributed at a 1:100 ratio with any remaining Colored Paper rounded up. If you have less than 100 of either Colored Paper, 1 will be given.
Adjusted Simple and Fancy Colored Paper to be obtained in the intended quantities.
As compensation we will also distribute Simple Colored Paper (x50) and Fancy Colored Paper (x2).
Any Simple Colored Paper purchased for 200 million mesos prior to the maintenance will be returned.
[Updated 4/30] Resolved an issue where some players were unable to participate in the Punch King event and received a 'Something went wrong. Please try again later.' error message.
[Updated 4/30] Resolved an issue where the Challenger World Shop ended earlier than intended. 
After the maintenance has been completed, players who participated in the Challenger World can access the Challenger World Shop from the NPC within Leap Zone.
[Updated 4/30] Resolved an issue where the 'I Finally Turned 21!' title description in-game incorrectly listed the Bonus EXP as +100% instead of +40%.
[Updated 4/30] Resolved an issue where the Receipt Damage Skin incorrectly displayed as the Wooden Damage Skin.
[Updated 4/29] Adjusted the subtext for the 'Major' section of the Campus Life event.
[Updated 4/29] Resolved an issue where Wild Hunter's Another Bite and Final Attack Boost Nodes were not applying to the HEXA Another Bite and HEXA Final Attack skills.
[Updated 4/29] Resolved an issue where the Phantom skill Ace in the Hole was unable to be used while the Tempest skill was active.
[Updated 4/29] Resolved an issue where the dialogue when using the Campus Point Coupon would display incorrectly.
[Updated 4/29] Resolved an issue where opening the My Maple U Student ID event would cause an incorrect chat message to appear.
Resolved an issue where text in the confirmation message for the Hasty Hunting MAX event was shown incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where some players incorrectly received a restriction message when accessing the Meso Market.
Resolved an issue where certain boss names appeared incorrectly in the Campus Life Internship event UI.

MAINTENANCE
CLASSIC
Apr 16, 2026
[COMPLETED] UNSCHEDULED SERVER MAINTENANCE - APRIL 17, 2026

[Updated April 17 at 7:00 AM PDT] The maintenance has been completed. Please restart your Nexon Launcher to ensure you receive the latest client update.

Our Closed Online Test maintenance was originally scheduled for April 21, 2026. However, to address some bugs/issues and ensure uninterrupted gameplay through the weekend, we will be performing an unscheduled server maintenance starting on Friday, April 17, 2026 at 5:00 AM PDT (8:00 AM EDT / 2:00 PM CEST / 10:00 PM AEST). We anticipate the maintenance to last approximately 2 hours, concluding around 7:00 AM PDT (10:00 AM EDT / 4:00 PM CEST / 12:00 AM AEST April 18).

Times:

Friday, April 17, 2026
PDT (UTC -7): 5:00 AM - 7:00 AM
EDT (UTC -4): 8:00 AM - 10:00 AM
CEST (UTC +2): 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM
AEST (UTC +10): 10:00 PM - 12:00 AM April 18

What will be unavailable:

All MapleStory Classic World game servers.

Changes and Updates:

Improved so that the Crafting UI tab now opens when selecting crafting tools.
Adjusted the stats of monsters in Kerning City Party Quest and the 2nd Job Advancement quests, making them easier to attack for certain jobs.
Added the ability to close/exit Player Shops by pressing the ESC key.
Adjusted the spawn rate of Iron Hogs on the Pig Beach map.
Adjusted the cost for Gem Processing when using the Arcforge.
Added an animation that plays when a character recovers HP and MP.
Resolved an issue where damage from multi-hit skills would not display if the monster was on top of the character.
Resolved an issue where the dialogue text was incorrect in the 'Letter for Lucas' quest.
Resolved an issue where players were unable to perform some actions after a trade was cancelled due to taking damage.
Resolved an issue where the Chat UI could not be adjusted after changing maps while minimized.
Resolved an issue where right-clicking a name in the Chat UI was inaccurate.
Resolved a visual issue with the Background Preview feature in the Cash Shop.
Resolved an issue where relisting an item in a Personal Store would cause the client to disconnect.
Resolved an issue where the dialogue text was incorrect in the 'Mrs. Ming Ming's First Worry' quest.

Note about Client Crashes:

We are aware that some players have been experiencing frequent game client crashes. Upon further investigation, we have found that many of these crashes have been occurring on game clients running on the Windows 10 operating system. Due to Windows 10 reaching the end of support in 2025, we recommend playing on Windows 11 for a smoother experience.

items.body:
MAINTENANCE
Apr 14, 2026
V.267 KNOWN ISSUES

The Known Issues section focuses on the major issues that have significantly impacted the game and community, and which our team is actively addressing. Please note that while we aim to cover the most impactful issues, this list will not encompass every reported issue. Check back regularly for updates on the status of these issues and information on resolved issues, or any new issues that may have been added.

Here you’ll find a list of known and resolved issues from the v.267 - MapleStory x One-Punch Man update:

KNOWN ISSUES
The Giant Oberon, Giant Titania, Giant Petite Pico, and Giant Brown Puppy Illusion Rings currently display incorrect names in-game, but they appear and function correctly. This issue will be fixed in the upcoming v.268 update.
Using a Royal Face Coupon on female characters is currently granting the Male Mischievous Smirk Face instead of the Female version.
Luxe Sauna coupons obtained from the Divine Wishing Bell loot box are unable to be used. For affected players, expired coupons will be redistributed in a future maintenance.
Terminus weapons and Terminus Defender rewards from the Yakuza Boss would not drop correctly.
RESOLVED ISSUES
April 9, 2026
Resolved an issue where certain non-NX item effects were unable to be toggled off.
Resolved an issue where Hayato's Fleeting Breath skill was doing less damage than intended.
Resolved an issue where checking a Friend's location would not work if players were in different channels.
Resolved an issue where the Favorites feature of the Event List would reset after viewing other tabs.
Resolved an issue where Sia's SHINE Stellar V - Formalhaut skill cooldown would not appear when used within a Skill Sequence.
Resolved an issue where Sia's Stellar II - Algol and SHINE Stellar II - Algol skills did not attack the correct amount of monsters.
Resolved an issue where MapleStory M's Reward Points were able to be claimed in the One-Punch Man Special World. For affected players, remaining mileage will be distributed in a future maintenance.
Resolved an issue where text in the Production Skill UI was not properly displayed.
Resolved an issue where Cash Shop items were missing for some characters that world leaped from Challenger Worlds. The duration of restored Cash Shop items has been extended.
Resolved an issue where Lv. 5 Eluna Necklace and Lv. 5 Eluna Earrings did not grant the EXP increase skill.
Resolved an issue where the AbsoLab Spirit Walker Fan obtained from the AbsoLab Weapon/Dominator Pendant Selection Box did not have set potentials. For affected players, the box has been distribuited via the Gift Drop and can be claimed within 2 weeks.
April 2, 2026
Resolved an issue where Exploration Missions 11 and 12 in the Hero’s Adventure Journal event granted untradable Karma Cubes instead of being tradable within world.
March 26, 2026
Resolved an issue where Magician's Arcane Overdrive skill tooltip incorrectly displayed as 'Damage' and not 'Final Damage'.
Resolved an issue where the following Sia Astelle skills could be activated when using Sol Janus:
Antares
Pole
Starlight
Resolved an issue with Sia Astelle's Enhanced Pole skill.
Resolved an issue where the Black Heart obtained from the Philosopher's Book was incorrectly set as a permanent item instead of having a 30-day duration.
Resolved an issue where the Tinkerer's Chest event quest did not appear after receiving the item from the Marvel Machine.
Resolved an issue where the Party HP UI did not display party member participation indicators during boss fights in Heroic Worlds.
Resolved an issue where Luminous' Liberation Orb skill was attacking slower than intended.
Resolved an issue where Paladin's Mighty Mjolnir's skill effects were shown incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where Wild Hunter's HEXA Another Bite and HEXA Final Attack skills were not benefitting from the Another Bite and Final Attack Boost Nodes.
Resolved an issue where unclaimed reward notifications for the concluded Twilight Eve event would appear when exiting the game.
Resolved an issue where the item description for the Goddess's Special Lv. 225 Gift in the Goddess's Blessing Pass event was displayed incorrectly.
Resolved an issue where the Firestarter skill from the Firestarter Ring was able to be added in the Buff Favorites UI.
Resolved an issue where the Chaotic Pitched Accessory Box obtained from Mystic Frontier was not appearing in the player's inventory.
[Updated 3/27/26] For affected players, Chaotic Pitched Accessory Boxes have been distributed and can be claimed via the Gift Drop.
Resolved an issue where some deleted skills could be crafted.
Resolved an issue with the 'Favorites' button function in the Event List UI.
Resolved an issue with The First Adversary boss' clone skill where it was not functioning as intended.
Resolved an issue when a Sia Astelle character attempts to leave Oort before completing the 'Fallen Stars' quest the guide message displays an incorrect quest to complete.
Resolved an issue where some Cash Shop tabs were not leading to the correct page when clicked.
Resolved an issue where the Maple Inc. ID Badge effect was not properly displayed for the Associate Executive Rank.
Resolved an issue where players were unable to claim rewards with the Reward Distribution feature despite dealing enough damage to the boss.
Resolved an issue where Tera Burning was unable to be applied to Zero characters during character creation.

items.bodyZh: **维护公告** 2026年3月19日 V.267 已知问题 “已知问题”部分主要关注对游戏和社区造成重大影响，且我们团队正在积极处理的主要问题。请注意，虽然我们力求涵盖影响最大的问题，但此列表不会包含所有已报告的问题。请定期查看此处，以获取这些问题状态的更新、已解决问题的信息，或可能新增的问题。 以下是 v.267 - 《冒险岛》x《一拳超人》更新中的已知问题与已解决问题列表： **已知问题** **通用** * 主要城镇（如射手村、无名村、赛尔尼姆广场等）中缺失尤莉亚 NPC。 * 从“哲学家的书”中获得的黑色心形道具被错误地设置为永久物品，而非30天期限。此问题将在下次维护中修复，已分发的永久黑色心形道具将被调整为原定的30天期限。 * 魔法师的“奥秘超载”技能描述中错误地显示为“伤害”而非“最终伤害”。 * 在英雄世界中进行首领战时，队伍HP界面不显示队员参与指示器。 * 事件列表UI中的“收藏”按钮功能有时无法正常工作。 * 圣骑士的“强力雷神之锤”技能效果显示不正确。 * 当西亚·阿斯特尔角色在完成“坠落的星辰”任务前尝试离开奥尔特时，引导信息会显示错误的需要完成的任务。 * 女神通行证中“女神的特别225级礼物”的物品描述显示不正确。 * 从神奇机器获得“工匠的宝箱”后，未出现相关的使用任务。 **已解决问题** **2026年3月20日** * 修复了“[重演活动] 野蛮”活动的签到计数显示不正确的问题。 **2026年3月19日** * 修复了玩家无法从金币市场领取金币的问题。受影响的玩家现在可以通过礼物箱领取金币，且金币市场已重新启用。 * 修复了唤灵斗师的“盘绕山脊”无法重新召唤的问题。 * 修复了英雄世界中某些首领因非预期设定掉落永恒碎片的问题。 * 修复了某些首领掉落错误物品的问题。 * 修复了夜光法师的“解放宝珠”未按预期叠加的问题。 * 修复了关闭系统消息有时会导致游戏软锁定的问题。 * 修复了英雄世界中扎昆和希拉掉落非西亚·阿斯特尔职业武器的问题。 * 修复了“[每周任务] 艾尔达的请求”任务未重置的问题。该任务将于今日 北京时间 2026年3月20日 8:00 重置，并将恢复于每周四 北京时间 2026年3月27日 8:00 的正常每周重置。 * 修复了购买高级通行证后，有时无法领取女神祝福通行证奖励的问题。 * 修复了西亚·阿斯特尔的5转强化未应用于其6转技能的问题。 **2026年3月18日** * 修复了新叶商城美食广场活动的某些技能效果未生效的问题。
